SELECT * FROM ( SELECT t.*, c.contract_name, c.contract_number, q.quotation_number, q.description, (SELECT wm_concat(hbm.bp_name ) FROM prj_project_bp ppb, hls_bp_master hbm WHERE ppb.project_id = pp.project_id AND ppb.bp_id = hbm.bp_id AND ppb.bp_categroy = 'CON_CONTRACT' AND ppb.Bp_Type IN ('TENANT', 'TENANT_SEC')) AS bp_name, pp.contract_number AS contract_number_con, pp.host_unit_id, (SELECT fou.unit_name FROM fnd_org_unit fou WHERE fou.unit_id = pp.host_unit_id) AS unit_name, (SELECT fc.company_full_name FROM fnd_company fc WHERE fc.company_id = pp.company_spv) AS company_name,
q.lpr_base_date,
(SELECT s.MEANING FROM sys_code_value_b_v s WHERE s.CODE = 'FND.BASE_RATE_TYPE' AND s.code_value = q.base_rate_type) AS base_rate_type_n,
q.int_rate_type, (SELECT s.MEANING FROM sys_code_value_b_v s WHERE s.CODE = 'CON.INT_RATE_TYPE' AND upper(s.code_value) = upper(q.int_rate_type)) AS int_rate_type_n, q.float_type, q.floating_way_rate, q.base_rate, q.int_rate,
(SELECT s.MEANING FROM sys_code_value_b_v s WHERE s.CODE = 'LPR_BASE_DATE' AND s.code_value = q.lpr_base_date) AS lpr_base_date_n, q.lpr_fixed_date, q.lpr_adjustment_term, (SELECT s.MEANING FROM sys_code_value_b_v s WHERE s.CODE = 'CON.FLOATING_RANGE_METHOD' AND s.code_value = q.lpr_adjustment_period) AS lpr_adjustment_period_n,
(select h.description from hls_price_list h where h.price_list = q.price_list) price_list_n,
( SELECT scvb.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scvb WHERE scb.code_id = scvb.code_id AND scvb.VALUE= t.STATUS AND scb.CODE = 'CON.FLOATING_REQ_LN_STATUS' AND scb.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND scvb.enabled_flag = 'Y' ) AS status_n FROM con_floating_rate_req_ln t LEFT JOIN con_contract c ON t.contract_id = c.contract_id LEFT JOIN prj_quotation q ON t.quotation_id = q.quotation_id LEFT JOIN prj_project pp ON c.project_id = pp.project_id )t1
t1.flt_req_id = #{fltReqId}
AND t1.flt_req_ln_id = #{fltReqLnId}
AND t1.contract_number LIKE concat('%',#{contractNumber},'%')
AND t1.bp_name LIKE concat('%',#{bpName},'%')
